data.headline: Hackathons at EF, Latino network via Latitud

picks.name: Entrepreneurs First (EF)
picks.one_liner: Hackathons are your fastest cofounder filter; EF hosts a huge share.
picks.insider: Go even if you won't win; build alongside potential cofounders all weekend.

picks.name: Latitud
picks.one_liner: LatAm founder community; perfect for LatAm fintech peers and investors.
picks.insider: Ask for intros to pre-seed angels backing LatAm fintech, not just the firm.

picks.name: El Gato Volador
picks.one_liner: Latino tech party; meet community warmly, then convert to coffee chats.
picks.insider: Posted on Luma; follow the calendar and RSVP early, spots fill.

data.watch_out: Only 2–4 weeks: post your landing dates on X now and pre-book coffees.

data.headline: Hacker house in the Mission, network in SoMa

picks.name: Hacker house in the Mission
picks.one_liner: Tight budget, cofounder hunt: roommates become your builder network fast.
picks.insider: Find openings via Luma/X posts and founder group chats, not listing sites.

picks.name: Mission / Valencia corridor
picks.one_liner: Best cafés, Latino community, sunnier, full of founders and hacker houses.
picks.insider: Stay near Valencia; 16th & Mission BART area is rough at night.

picks.name: Shared room in SoMa / South Park
picks.one_liner: Walk to Luma events, hackathons and angels during a short sprint.
picks.insider: Great by day, empty at night; pick blocks carefully.

data.watch_out: Cheap 'near Union Square' listings are often Tenderloin. Never wire deposits before a video tour.

data.headline: Lime pass by day, Muni to save

picks.name: Lime (monthly pass)
picks.one_liner: Cheapest fast way to hop between cafés, hackathons and investor coffees.
picks.insider: Grab the monthly pass on day one; ~20 min gets you almost anywhere.

picks.name: Muni bus / metro
picks.one_liner: Tight budget backup for daytime trips, like to the Mission's Latino scene.
picks.insider: Add Clipper to Apple/Google Wallet; skip buying paper tickets.

picks.name: Waymo / Lyft / Uber
picks.one_liner: Safe ride home after late fintech events; try Waymo once.
picks.insider: Save rideshares for nights only; Waymo feels safer after dark.

data.watch_out: BART is for airports and East Bay only, not for getting around inside SF.

data.headline: Founders Café base, cheap backups nearby

picks.name: AngelList Founders Café
picks.one_liner: Free founder base with cofounder-matching mixers — exactly your two goals.
picks.insider: Invite-only: apply for access before you land on Nov 9.

picks.name: Capital One Café
picks.one_liner: Quiet, free seating and solid Wi‑Fi fits a tight budget.
picks.insider: Not just for customers; out-of-towners rarely know you can sit all day.

picks.name: Day-pass coworkings (~$10/day)
picks.one_liner: Cheap desk days beat a monthly plan on a 2–4 week trip.
picks.insider: Buy passes only on heavy work days; use free spots otherwise.

data.watch_out: Founders Café needs approval; apply early. Book angel chats at Sightglass, where founders actually close deals.

data.headline: Sofía: start with LatAm fintech founders, pre-seed angels, and AI hackathon engineers who could become your cofounder.

targets.who: LatAm-focused fintech founder in SF (seed to Series A)
targets.why: Knows LatAm SMB payments pain, investors, and potential technical cofounders
targets.linkedin_search: founder fintech Latin America San Francisco
targets.dm: Hi! I'm Sofía, building AI invoicing for LatAm SMBs. I'm in SF from Nov 9. Your path selling fintech into LatAm is exactly what I'm figuring out. 30 min, coffee's on me? Happy to show you a quick demo.

targets.who: Pre-seed angel who backs LatAm or fintech founders
targets.why: Writes first checks and gives honest feedback on early fintech traction
targets.linkedin_search: angel investor pre-seed fintech LatAm San Francisco
targets.dm: Hi! I'm Sofía, building AI invoicing for Latin American SMBs. I'm in SF Nov 9 for a few weeks. I'd love your honest take on my demo, not a pitch. Coffee's on me, any café near you?

targets.who: AI engineer active in Cerebral Valley / AI Tinkerers hackathons
targets.why: Potential technical cofounder; hackathon builders ship fast and like real problems
targets.linkedin_search: AI engineer hackathon Cerebral Valley San Francisco fintech
targets.dm: Hi! Saw you build at SF AI hackathons. I'm Sofía, working on AI invoicing for LatAm SMBs and looking for a technical cofounder. In SF from Nov 9. Coffee's on me? Or should we hack together this weekend?

data.x_post: Landing in SF Nov 9 for ~3 weeks 🇺🇸✈️ Building AI invoicing for Latin American SMBs. Looking to meet fintech founders, pre-seed angels and AI engineers (cofounder hunting!). Coffee's on me ☕ DMs open.
